{{Infobox Item |defver = 2 |version1 = Uncharged |version2 = Charged |name1 = Venator bow (uncharged) |name2 = Venator bow |image1 = [[File:Venator bow (uncharged).png]] |image2 = [[File:Venator bow.png]] |release = [[11 January]] [[2023]] |update = Secrets of the North & More! |members = Yes |quest = No |tradeable1 = Yes |tradeable2 = No |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options1 = Wield, Drop |options2 = Wield, Check, Uncharge |examine = A bow used by hunters from a forgotten empire. |value = 750000 |weight = 4.500 |exchange1 = Yes |exchange2 = No |id1 = 27612 |id2 = 27610 |leagueRegion = Fremennik }} {{Synced switch |version1 = [[File:Venator bow (uncharged) detail.png|left|130px]] |version2 = [[File:Venator bow detail.png|left|130px]] }} The '''venator bow''' is a two-handed [[ranged weapon]] that was once used by the venators, who were hunters and scouts that served the [[Zarosian Empire]]. Requiring level 80 in [[Ranged]] to wield, it is made by combining five [[venator shard]]s. It can fire any type of arrow, including [[Dragon arrow|dragon arrows]], and has an [[attack range]] of 6 (8 when using the "Longrange" combat style). The bow can be charged with [[ancient essence]] to gain a unique [[passive effect]] that consumes charges, although the uncharged version can still be used as a regular bow. The passive effect enables the bow to be used against multiple targets with one attack, with the arrow bouncing to up to two other nearby monsters. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |version1 = Uncharged |version2 = Charged |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = 0 |arange = +90 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 0 |dcrush = 0 |dmagic = 0 |drange = 0 |str = 0 |rstr = 25 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = 2h |speed = 5 |attackrange = 6 |combatstyle = Bow |image1 = [[File:Venator bow (uncharged) equipped male.png|180px]] |image2 = [[File:Venator bow equipped male.png|180px]] |altimage1 = [[File:Venator bow (uncharged) equipped female.png|180px]] |altimage2 = [[File:Venator bow equipped female.png|180px]] }} {{CombatStyles|Bow|speed=5|attackrange=6}} == Creation == {{Recipe |members = Yes |ticks = |mat1 = Venator shard |mat1quantity = 5 |output1 = Venator bow (uncharged) }} ==Passive effect and charging== [[File:Venator bow passive effect.gif|thumb|250px|left|The venator bow's ricochet effect.]] [[File:A Mysterious Quest- Boss Rewards (3).png|thumb|An illustration of the bow's ricochet effect:
- Blue squares: Initial target.
- Purple squares: Potential secondary targets.
- Orange squares: Potential tertiary targets.
- Black squares: Unreachable targets.]] The venator bow has a passive effect that requires [[ancient essence]] to use. When attacking a target in a [[multicombat area]], the arrow will try to bounce to another target near the first. Then, the attack can bounce again, either back to the first target or to a third one. Each hit rolls accuracy independently, and the second and third hits both have a max hit equal to two-thirds of the original max hit, rounded down. Bouncing arrows from the venator bow will only hit targets within two tiles of the original target’s centre, except for 2x2 targets which search for centre tiles within 2 tiles of any of the 2x2 target's tiles. Bounces can still occur if an attack misses or one of the targets dies. A different sound effect plays depending on if the arrow hits one, two, or three times. Each [[ancient essence]] adds 1 charge to the bow, with it being able to hold up to 50,000 charges (costing {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Ancient essence|1}}}} coins per attack, and a total of {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Ancient essence|50000}}}} to fully charge it with 50,000 [[Ancient essence|essence]]). Players can configure the charges while the weapon is in their bank by right-clicking on Configure-Charges, as long as players have the required materials. One charge is deducted per attack, and it will always lose one charge regardless of how many bounces occur from that projectile. Assuming the bow is used on rapid, the hourly rate of using it is {{NoCoins|({{GEP|Ancient essence|1}})*1500}} coins. The fully charged bow will last for 33.33 hours of continuous combat before reverting to its uncharged form, Upon death in the Wilderness, if the item is protected, no charges will be lost. The bow will notify the player of the charges remaining at increments of 500 charges. It will also notify the player when 100 and 50 charges remain. Un-charging the bow returns all essence to the player's inventory. Arrows that bounce to undead targets while wearing a [[Salve amulet(ei)]] do not benefit from offensive prayer bonuses, such as those granted by [[rigour]]. [[File:Venator Bow Target Center Tiles.png|thumb|This image shows example centre/SW tiles which the venator bow utilises in determining if it can bounce.]] All damage from the venator bow benefits from the minimum damage of [[Seeking arrow|seeking arrows.]] While the first hit of the venator bow benefits from the minimum damage of flat armour combined with seeking arrows, the second and third bounced hits do not benefit from negative flat armour. === Bouncing rules === {{Obsolete|The venator bow now finds targets "more reliably".|update=Update:Summer Sweep Up - Hunter & Skilling}} [[File:Venator Bow 2x2 Examples.png|thumb|This image illustrates how the Venator Bow interacts with 2x2 monsters. Blue squares indicate the tile from which the arrow is bouncing, while purple squares show the potential bounce range. Green squares represent successful bounce examples, and red squares show unsuccessful ones. Each colored square includes directional callouts such as "C" for centre tile or "SW" for south-west tile to clarify the logic behind each interaction.]] There are 2 main rules to follow, with sub set of their own rules. # Can monster accept the bounce. # Can monster send the bounce. For "Can monster accept the bounce" rules are as follows: # 1x1 accepts bounce to it, if targeting monster finds 1x1’s tile. # 2x2 accepts bounce to it, if targeting monster finds 2x2’s SW tile. # 3x3 accepts bounce to it, if targeting monster passes these rules. ## Odd sized (1x1,3x3,5x5) needs to find 3x3's CENTRE and SW tiles. ## 2x2 needs to find 3x3's CENTRE tile. ## 4x4 needs to find 3x3's SW tile. # 4x4 accepts bounce to it, if targeting monster passes these rules. ## Odd sized (1x1,3x3,5x5) needs to find 4x4's CENTRE and SW tiles. ## 2x2 needs to find 4x4's CENTRE and CENTRE SW tiles. ## 4x4 needs to find 4x4's SW and CENTRE SW tiles. # 5x5 accepts bounce to it, if targeting monster passes these rules. ## Odd sized (1x1,3x3,5x5) needs to find 5x5's CENTRE and SW tiles. ## 2x2 needs to find 5x5's CENTRE and CENTRE SW tiles. ## 4x4 needs to find 5x5's SW and CENTRE SW tiles. For "Can monster send the bounce" rules are as follows: # 1x1, 3x3, and 5x5 sends bounce if it finds targets SW and CENTRE tile from its CENTRE tile. # 2x2 sends bounce on two different rule sets depending on target monster size. ## If it finds targets CENTRE tile from any of its tiles (monster is ≤ 3x3). ## If it finds targets CENTRE and CENTRE SW tile from any of its tiles (monster is ≥ 4x4). # 4x4 sends bounce if it finds targets SW and CENTRE SW tiles from any of its middle 2x2 tiles. == Uses == Because of its potential to deal up to 233% of its standard max hit per shot, the venator bow is highly efficient at killing tightly-packed enemies in multicombat areas. Additionally, the arrows' tendency to bounce into nearby non-aggressive targets can help draw aggro, requiring less attention from the player. As such, the bow can be considered a lower cost-per-hour alternative to [[Barrage spells|barraging]] or [[Chinchompa|chinchompas]]. Popular spots to use it include [[Abyssal demon|abyssal demons]] and [[Mutated Bloodveld|mutated bloodvelds]] in the [[Catacombs of Kourend]]. The bow is ineffective in single-combat areas, and on most enemies with a [[size]] of 3x3 or larger (such as [[Greater demon|greater demons]]), since the bounce radius of 2 tiles makes it impossible for arrows to bounce from one large enemy to another unless stacked. It is very effective against the [[Grotesque Guardians]] due to the bosses' very low Defence and being stackable, allowing players to hit [[Dawn]] twice if [[Dusk]] is on top of her. Similarly, it is very useful in dealing with the [[Fremennik warband seer|Fremennik Warband Seer]] in the [[Fortis Colosseum]], as it always bounces back and defeats the seer in one attack provided the berserker has already been defeated. It is also one of the best weapons for the Attacker in [[Barbarian Assault]], as the enemies spawn out on top of each other, and all 3 hits benefit from the flat +5 damage from Attacker levels. The bow is also an effective weapon for farming monsters that drop [[champion's scroll]]s. The bow is highly effective in a range of Slayer tasks, such as: * [[Ankou]] (Catacombs of Kourend) * [[Araxyte]]s (Level-146) * [[Abyssal demon]]s (Catacombs of Kourend) * [[Custodian stalker]]s (Auburnvale dungeon) * [[Dagannoth]] (Lighthouse or Catacombs of Kourend) * [[Dust devil]]s (Catacombs of Kourend, Smoke Dungeon) * [[Fire giant]]s (Catacombs of Kourend) * [[Hellhound]]s (Level-122 in the Catacombs of Kourend) * [[Mutated bloodveld]]s (Catacombs of Kourend or Meiyerditch Laboratory) * [[Warped Jelly|Warped jellies]] (Catacombs of Kourend) {{clear|left}} === Venom === When paired with a [[serpentine helm]] and [[Poison#Weapon poisoning|poisoned]] arrows, the venator bow can inflict [[venom]] on multiple targets with a single shot, significantly boosting damage output in multi-combat areas. A cost-effective approach is using [[Adamant arrow#Poison++|adamant arrows (p++)]], which are commonly obtained from various monsters. There appears to be little to no difference in venom application rates between poison types, so regular weapon poison suffices. The slight DPS loss from weaker arrowheads is outweighed by the substantial DPS increase from applying venom so efficiently and affordably. ==Products== {{Uses material list|Venator bow}} ==Sound effects== {{SFXTableHead}} {{SFXLine|file=Equip ranged.wav|desc=Wielding}} {{SFXLine|file=Venator bow attack.wav|desc=Attacking}} {{SFXLine|file=Venator bow ricochet 1.wav|desc=First ricochet}} {{SFXLine|file=Venator bow ricochet 2.wav|desc=Second ricochet}} {{SFXTableBottom}} ==Used in recommended equipment== {{Used in recommended equipment|Venator bow}} ==Comparison between other ranged weapons== {{Ranged weapons comparison}} ==Transcript== {{hastranscript|item}} ==Gallery== Venator bow concept art.jpg|Concept art of the venator bow by [[Mod Jerv]]. ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 19 August 2026 |update = Summer Sweep Up - Hunter & Skilling |change = Updated the venator bow to take advantage of new engine capabilities, allowing it to find new targets more reliably. }} {{Subject changes |date = 5 March 2025 |update = Game Jam: Charges QoL |change = The venator bow supports a bank item option for changing charges. }} {{Subject changes |date = |update = |change = The venator bow now counts as a Zarosian item in the God Wars Dungeon. }} {{Subject changes |date = 2 February 2023 |update = Wilderness Boss Rework Tweaks & More |change = * Remaining charges chat message are now broadcasted more frequently, at every increment of 500 charges, and when hitting 100 and 50 charges. * Secondary hits should now roll their own accuracy checks instead of using the one from the initial hit. * Arrows can now ricochet even if their target dies. * The speed of the ricocheting arrows has been increased. }} {{Subject changes |date = 12 January 2023 |update = Secrets of the North & More! |type = hotfix |change = * All bounces will correctly hit up to 66% of max hit damage. * The Venator bow is now able to be used within [[Barbarian Assault]]. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ==Trivia== * "Venator", in Latin, means "hunter". * "Venator" was a rank used in the [[Zarosian Empire]]. According to the [[tatty page]] found during [[Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire]], venators served as scouts. * The charged venator bow is currently the only bow in-game to show its bow string when wielded. * When pitched in [[Update:A Mysterious Quest: Boss Rewards|the poll blog]], the item's name was "Bloodletter bow". This was because the name of the quest and its rewards were polled by the development team as a "Mysterious Quest", where they wished to keep the Zarosian nature of the rewards a secret. ** The true name of the quest and its rewards from the boss were then revealed in the [[Winter Summit 2022]] a month later. * The [[Zaryte bow]], a proposed reward from [[Nex]], closely resembles the venator bow, including its Zarosian origin. *A [[Jagex Moderator]]-[[Venator bow (rotten)|exclusive ''rotten'' variant]] of this item exists which allows the user to kill any player instantly. {{Phantom Muspah}} {{Ranged weapons}} [[Category:Items with charges]] [[Category:Walk animation modifiers]]
